findings.what: AC-204 not implemented: recording leave does not surface affected booked appointments; no affected-appointments list, no bulk reassign, no leave-cancel with re-book email. Only the v1 single reassign (staff.ts:105) exists. Withholding rescheduling_required is justified, the rest is not.
A failed acceptOffer for any reason (e.g. leave recorded after the offer was sent) voids the offer without passing the slot to the next queued patient.
Slots freed on a doctor's leave day still trigger waitlist offer emails that cannot be accepted (offerFreedSlot has no leave check).
Check-then-insert for 'entry has no pending offer' is not atomic; concurrent cancellations of different slots can give one patient two pending offers.
No concurrency test for reassignment racing an online booking (AC-205); safety rests on the unique index without a test verifying it.
